gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Nostalgic from the first glance, Visitor gapes at every e. Noto Sans Ugaritic is approachable, keeping lowercase nearly as tall as its caps, its open mouths like unjoined chalk arcs.

gen-dafont-visitor-gf-onest: Visitor has gaping e mouths and short ascenders over big bowls. Onest, a sans-serif with a gentle monotone line and no ink pooling where curves turn, is the easygoing partner.
